main.description: Keyed by the organization's DID, in the member's own account: in their public records for a membership anyone may see, or in their repo in the organization's space (type dev.knotless.org, keyed self) for a hidden one. Counts only while the organization's dev.knotless.orgMember record of the member has joinedAt set. Deleting it leaves the organization.

description: A member's side of an organization's membership: that they accepted its invitation, and are a member while they keep it.
